div.head: VI Atr Lat Inscr.
div.note: Latin paraphrase of VI Atr (early 11th c.; K = Cotton Claudius A III f. 30), text in column K (Liebermann’s text; until October 2026 in column T). This passage has no Old English equivalent; Liebermann gives no German translation.; T: corrected against Gesetze I, October 2026 (was “(Liebermann’s Latin Paraphrase)”, now “∅ (moved to K)”); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads), October 2026 (was “16 May 1008 – 13 May 1011; 1008 (Wormald); Enham”, now “16 May 1008–13 May 1011 (Liebermann); 1008 (Wormald); Enham”); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “16 May 1008–13 May 1011 (Liebermann); 1008 (Wormald); Enham”, now “16 May 1008–13 May 1011 (Liebermann, I p. 247); 1008 (Wormald, MEL pp. 333–5); Enham”); BQ: page of each of Liebermann’s texts and of his German, checked against Liebermann, Gesetze I (our double-read transcription), October 2026 (e.g. was “(empty)”, now “K 247”; 64 rows of VI Atr Lat)
